title: On the Yamabe flow in a bounded domain
summary: This paper investigates the dynamical behaviors of solutions to the Yamabe flow via the modified potential well method. We first establish the local existence and regularity of weak solutions for the flow. Several new results concerning global existence and blowup are obtained by classifying initial data into stable and unstable sets. Specifically, solutions with initial data in the stable set exist globally and extinguish in finite time, whereas those originating from unstable initial data blow up in infinite time.
